projects.title: Cloud Migration Platform
projects.bodyText: Built a Kubernetes-based platform that reduced deployment time by 60% and improved system reliability to 99.99% uptime. Led cross-functional team of 8 engineers across backend, frontend, and DevOps. Implemented automated CI/CD pipeline using GitHub Actions and deployed to AWS.

projects.title: Real-Time Analytics Dashboard
projects.bodyText: Created a real-time analytics dashboard processing 10M+ events daily using React, WebSockets, and PostgreSQL. Implemented data visualization with D3.js and optimized queries for sub-second latency. Scaled to support 100K concurrent users with Redis caching.

projects.title: E-Commerce API
projects.bodyText: Designed and built production-grade REST API for e-commerce platform handling millions of transactions. Implemented payment processing, inventory management, and order fulfillment. Achieved 99.99% uptime with comprehensive monitoring and alerting.
